parameters.prompt: The exact crocodile in the reference stays in the same spot and keeps its head, body and all four feet still and facing the same direction the whole time. Only the tail moves: the tail curls in toward its body, then whips once outward in a short arc close to the ground, then curls back to exactly the original tail pose and holds it. The tail keeps the same length. Exactly four legs and one tail. No turning, rotating, spinning, rolling, walking, jumping, biting or moving across the frame. Keep the same view, scales and colours. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character including the full tail stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
